step_a: Infer every ship nose, remove its embedded minority-color particles, eject the same count outward, and clip each ray at the canvas boundary.
intermediate: The ordered ship records after ejection: each inferred nose, payload count, clipped ray cells, and visible ray length.
step_b: Measure the visible post-clipping ray lengths and retain only the stable first maximum while preserving all hulls.
why_b_depends_on_a: Payload count alone does not determine the visible ray: the nose location and boundary clipping intervene. Selecting the largest original payload before ejection retains a different ship in the qualified curriculum and changes the final grid.
